objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Let $T$ be a minimal (under inclusion) transversal of $\mathcal C$... Hence $\pi(T)\in S_\infty$
objection.witness: A minimal transversal of a family of finite, pairwise-intersecting sets need not be finite. Thus π(T) may be undefined, and the argument proves self-duality only for finite minimal transversals. For example, the family {{x,t_n}:n≥1} has the infinite minimal transversal {t_n:n≥1}.
